test_title: PYST 56: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north. No one sits to the left of O. Only four people sit between O and I. Only three people sit to the right of K. J sits to the immediate left of N. L is not an immediate neighbour of K. Who sits at the rightmost end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) No one sits to the left of O.

2) Only four people sit between O and I.

3) J sits to the immediate left of N.

4) L is not an immediate neighbour of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/849c11ae9ffdbb9e26a507f9a822ed7b4dc9b0354bd71dd7f0ce7a702e59de6f.png] 

So,** L** sits at the rightmost end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
